title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
hints: sorted(nums)[-k] is O(n log n) and is the right first answer. A min-heap that never grows past k elements gives O(n log k). The interviewer will then ask for average O(n).

Quickselect: pick a pivot, partition the array into values below, equal to and above it, and recurse only into the one part that contains the k-th largest position. Average O(n) because the expected work halves each round.
Choose the pivot at random and partition three ways (less, equal, greater): with only two parts, an array full of duplicates degrades to O(n^2).
